subject: Close runbook: executive linchpins & boardroom cadence
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@quirksoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close runbook: executive linchpins & boardroom cadence

Emily —

Thanks again for the detailed evaluation feedback last week. As we head into the final close window, I want to confirm the executive-level touchpoints and a short EB (executive briefing) cadence so QuirkSoft has the right sponsors engaged on the decision day. I sketched a compact runbook and a proposed sequence of boardroom-level meetings and asks; attaching the MAP (mutual action plan) and a short evaluation checklist.

High-level asks:
- Confirm primary executive linchpin (name + best contact) for the close day
- Confirm two 30-min boardroom sync windows (one for the champion + IT security, one with procurement + CFO) during the week 9/7–9/11
- Agree on success criteria for the quick EB (what a sign-off looks like) — see EvalChecklist_QuirkSoft.pdf

Proposed initial slots (PT):
1) Tue 2026-09-08 09:00–09:30 — Exec sponsor (virtual) + product deep-dive (our CTO + your VP Product)
2) Thu 2026-09-10 14:00–14:30 — Procurement + Legal (prep for PO)

If those roughly work, I’ll lock calendar invites and circulate a one-pager for each meeting. Marissa/Ben — can you confirm who on our side will be the point for the boardroom demos (I can lead the sponsor brief + outcomes)?

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: MAP_QuirkSoft_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), EvalChecklist_QuirkSoft.pdf (decision criteria)

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@quirksoft.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@quirksoft.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close runbook: executive linchpins & boardroom cadence

Hannah —

Appreciate the proactive plan and the materials. Quick answers:
- Primary linchpin: Darrin Cole (SVP, Product) — he wants to be present for the sponsor brief and the demo. Best contact: darrin.cole@quirksoft.com, +1 212-555-6627.
- The two proposed slots are reasonable; Tue 9/8 09:00 PT is tight for Darrin but Thu 9/10 14:00 PT is ideal. Can we do an alternate for the sponsor brief on Wed 9/9 10:00 PT?
- Procurement copied — they’ll confirm PO process timeline but flagged that they need a short summary of compliance artifacts (SOC2 scope + data residency notes).

If you can send a two-slide sponsor brief and the compliance bullet list, I’ll route to Darrin and legal.

—Emily
Emily Zhao
Head of Strategic Alliances
QuirkSoft
emily.zhao@quirksoft.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close runbook: executive linchpins & boardroom cadence

Hannah —

I can own the sponsor brief (two slides) and Ben will take the technical demo. Laura, can you pull the SOC2 extract + retention policy notes into a one-page compliance summary? We should also prepare a short fallback policy (model variant + dedicated capacity) in case they ask about latency/SLO on day one.

Proposed internal prep:
- Wed 9/2: Draft sponsor brief + compliance one-pager (Marissa/Laura)
- Thu 9/3: Dry run 30m with Ben (demo flow + Q&A plan)
- Fri 9/4: Final collateral packet to Emily

Ben — aim to keep demo to 12 minutes, 6 minutes for Q&A, and a one slide slide-deck for the handoff to procurement.

Marissa
Account Lead, Strategic Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@quirksoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, procurement@quirksoft.com
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Close runbook: executive linchpins & boardroom cadence

Emily —

Thanks — wed 9/9 10:00 PT for the sponsor brief works for us as an alternate. I’ll tentatively book both Tue 9/8 09:00 PT and Wed 9/9 10:00 PT for Darrin and mark the 9/10 procurement slot as confirmed. We’ll only keep the slot that Darrin confirms.

Deliverables timeline (per our internal plan):
- 9/2 EOD: Sponsor brief (Marissa) + compliance one-pager (Laura)
- 9/3 11:00 PT: Dry run with Ben (30m)
- 9/4 EOD: Collateral packet to Emily (Hannah)

I’m attaching the MAP V1 and the EvalChecklist that maps exhibits to sign-off criteria. Also adding the HubSpot link to the deal for reference.

Calendar invites will come from my account but labeled: "QuirkSoft — Exec Sponsor Brief (Redwood)" and "QuirkSoft — Procurement + Legal (Redwood)". If procurement/legal need any extra artifacts, Laura will coordinate.

Hannah

Attachments: MAP_QuirkSoft_v1.xlsx, EvalChecklist_QuirkSoft.pdf

Subject: Confirmed: EB cadence & boardroom packet (final)

Emily / team —

Following our prep, all collateral is attached and the calendar invites are live:
- Wed 2026-09-09 10:00–10:30 PT — Exec Sponsor Brief (tentative for Darrin Cole)
- Thu 2026-09-10 14:00–14:30 PT — Procurement + Legal (confirmed)

Attached files: Boardroom_Agenda_v2.docx (final), MAP_QuirkSoft_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan — owners + dates), EvalChecklist_QuirkSoft.pdf (decision criteria mapping).

Quick notes for the brief:
- Goal: get verbal sponsor commitment for production pilot + timeline to PO by EOW 9/11
- Success criteria: exec confirmation of pilot scope + acceptance of SLO/region constraints in the MAP
- Procurement asks: sample PO language and an expected billing cadence (we can provide a standard P-card or net-30 template)

If Darrin confirms Wed morning, we will keep both invites and push a short one-page deck to his inbox a half hour before the call. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Hannah
